questions.question_en: Which spatial relationship identifies Road advantage?
questions.question_te: రోడ్డు ప్రయోజనం గురించి సరైన వివరణ/సంబంధం ఏది?
options: Specialised movement of liquids, gases or suitable slurries
High-volume land line-haul using fixed rail infrastructure
Rapid long-distance movement for suitable urgent or high-value loads
Flexible local and last-mile movement on usable road networks

questions.question_en: Why can a low line-haul freight rate fail to give the lowest delivered cost?
questions.question_te: Low line-haul rate final delivered cost lowest ఎందుకు కాకపోవచ్చు?
options: Transfers, first/last mile, time and handling add costs
Only distance matters in every shipment
All terminals operate without cost or delay
option_explanations: Time can affect inventory/perishability.
The whole logistics chain must be counted.
Goods/timing/reliability matter.
Transfers can be costly.
questions.heading: పాఠం 2 — భారత రవాణా పటం: గ్రామదారి నుంచి రైలు, ఓడరేవు, విమానం వరకు
questions.excerpt: Total logistics costలో origin/destination handling, transfers, first/last mile, inventory/time, reliability ఉంటాయి. Per-tonne line-haul cost alone final delivered cost కాదు. Terrain, weather, axle/draft limits, congestion availabilityను ప్రభావితం చేస్తాయి.

questions.question_en: Which waterway pair is correct?
questions.question_te: Waterway–system సరైన pair ఏది?
option_explanations: NW3 is a Kerala canal system.
NW1 is Ganga–Bhagirathi–Hooghly.
NW4 concerns peninsular waterways.
NW2 follows the Brahmaputra in Assam.
questions.heading: పాఠం 2 — భారత రవాణా పటం: గ్రామదారి నుంచి రైలు, ఓడరేవు, విమానం వరకు
questions.excerpt: Golden Quadrilateral Delhi–Mumbai–Chennai–Kolkata metropolitan circuitను connect చేస్తుంది. NW1 Ganga–Bhagirathi–Hooghly; NW2 Brahmaputra; NW3 Kerala West Coast Canal/canal system; NW4 Krishna/Godavari and connected canal stretchesతో సంబంధం. Legal declaration all stretches year-round large-vessel navigation proof కాదు.

questions.question_en: What does national-waterway declaration not prove by itself?
questions.question_te: Nationalwaterway declaration alone ఏది prove చేయదు?
options: Every stretch is navigable year-round for every vessel
option_explanations: Physical constraints still matter.
Phasing can occur.
Navigability requires actual depth, fairway and service conditions.
Declaration establishes recognition.
